name: Brassic
description: A group of working-class friends finding unconventional ways to win at life in suburban northern England. These lads have dealt, scammed, bribed and conned their way through adolescence, but now, their dealing and stealing is catching up with them and a whole load of trouble is heading their way.

videos.title: A Very Brassic Christmas
videos.overview: The plan is to kick back, relax and enjoy life to the max. But then comes the inevitable. A call from Dr Chris saying his aunt is in crisis and needs looking after and a robbery at Tyler's school ruining his Nativity. Vinnie, Erin Tommo, Cardi, Carol Ashely and JJ must now bring on their A-Game and help save Christmas the Brassic way. Bring on a heist at a winter wonderland, a fight with a man called Dick Dolphin, babysitting Chris's Aunt and the best Nativity ever staged.

videos.title: Your Pony's A C...
videos.overview: Vinnie's plan to steal a tiny horse is thwarted by a jar of chloroform and a pigeon.

videos.title: Big Sandy's Funeral
videos.overview: Needing cash for stripper Big Sandy's funeral, the lads decide to rob her boss's safe - but plans go awry when they get trapped in a sewer.

videos.title: The Fight
videos.overview: A rival traveller challenges Ash to a fight. But Vinnie gets suspicious when Ash ends up in hospital.

videos.title: The Fish
videos.overview: Desperate to pay back McCann, the boys agree to help a woman get revenge on her ex-husband.

videos.title: Ronnie Croft
videos.overview: A raid on a weed farm goes wrong when Erin's brother turns up and someone accidentally gets kidnapped.

videos.title: Antique Dildo
videos.overview: Vinnie nicks a car containing McCann's stolen antiques and must find the thief or face dismemberment.

videos.title: The Circus
videos.overview: Vinnie has been hiding out in his weed shed since faking his own death to escape from local gangster Terrance McCann. Tommo and Erin need his help and try to lure him out of hiding with a new business proposition and together with the lads they plot to rob a travelling circus. With the help of a disgruntled clown, Mr Popov, the gang aim to make this theft a 'roaring' success.

videos.title: A Nice Day Out
videos.overview: Vinnie is tasked with collecting a guy called Tony Tillerton. It seems like a simple task... Meanwhile, a booze cruise to France is under way.

videos.title: Antique Hunters
videos.overview: Vinnie agrees to grow weed on an industrial scale for McCann and the lads get busy setting up a new grow shed. Meanwhile, Erin attends a disastrous dinner party with Jake's family and Tommo hatches a plan to steal some erotic furniture to re-vamp the Rat & Cutter. But what starts as a simple robbery quickly descends into bedlam when a rival gang of thieves turn up and the lads find themselves joining an elaborate treasure hunt.

videos.title: The Intruder
videos.overview: Suffering from insomnia, Vinnie decides to have a chilled night in at the local pub, but things take a sinister turn when a stranger breaks in.

videos.title: The Festival
videos.overview: Ordered by McCann to sell all the weed they have grown, the lads decide to throw a music festival in Jim's field.

videos.title: Stealing a Wedding
videos.overview: When a close friend gets engaged, Vinnie is determined to throw them the best wedding he can muster, and so decides to steal one.

videos.title: The Great Bull Semen Heist
videos.overview: Vinnie finally gets released from prison and with the newly promoted Detective Carl Slater watching his every move, he is doing his best to lie low.

videos.title: Gideon's Mum Funeral
videos.overview: Vinnie's friend Gideon calls to say his mother has passed away and asks Vin to help him honour her final wishes.

videos.title: The Ransom
videos.overview: Ashley's cousin Doolan has been kidnapped and his uncle Francis calls on Vinnie to be the bag drop man in his ransom.

videos.title: Classic Cars
videos.overview: Mr and Mrs Bishop are back and the gang are once again caught up in their bitter divorce battle.

videos.title: Parenthood
videos.overview: When Ashley decides that he wants to track down his real father, Vinnie and the gang promise to do everything they can to help find him.

videos.title: The Keithy Problem
videos.overview: Erin's brother Ronnie returns to Hawley claiming he has turned over a new leaf. Erin reluctantly convinces farmer Jim to let him stay in his spare room, but it's not long before Ronnie and his con mate Keithy cause total havoc.

videos.title: Bees
videos.overview: The gang are in a buzz when Vinnie is tasked by Chinese Dan to steal some beehives, so the lads scope out a nearby village famous for making local honey.

videos.title: The Shack
videos.overview: Driven mad with worry, Erin has told Vinnie about the money she owes McCann. But when McCann's men kidnap Tyler as a warning, Vinnie is so furious that he kidnaps McCann's twins in retaliation and the situation worsens.

videos.title: Getting There
videos.overview: The gang is back and ready to hit the road for Ringo and Babs' Welsh wedding, while Vinnie gets wind of Erin's hiding place and uses the road trip as an excuse to get her back.

videos.title: Day at the Dogs
videos.overview: The gang sees a cash cow with a retired racing greyhound, but a mystery begins when the animal finds a human foot during training.

videos.title: Lost in the Woods
videos.overview: What should have been a fun, lads-only camping trip turns into a nightmare when the gang end up horrendously lost.

videos.title: Exotic Zoo
videos.overview: When Manolito, Davey MacDonagh's eccentric distributor, offends Vinnie, the gang decide to get revenge by raiding his exotic zoo.

videos.title: Amy
videos.overview: A young woman claims to be Erin’s half-sister, but is she telling the truth? The gang attempt to steal a rare and valuable rose.

videos.title: Saint Erin (Murder Mystery)
videos.overview: After a tip-off from Dr Chris, Vinnie and the gang don some fancy dress and join a posh murder mystery evening at a stately home to gain access to its cellars stocked with valuable vintage wine.

videos.title: An Unexpected Guest
videos.overview: Vinnie befriends an elderly woman who is hiding from Davey MacDonagh. Can the gang get their new friend to safety without Davey finding out?

videos.title: Davey's House
videos.overview: Having let their prisoner slip through their fingers, the MacDonaghs are on the war path and convinced that the gang had something to do with it.

videos.title: Eddie
videos.overview: A chaotic 24 hours as the gang takes an unlikely hostage and escorts him on his bizarre round of errands.

videos.title: Missing Body
videos.overview: A World War II-era bunker gets uncovered near Jim and Shirley's farms, but the discovery leads to a catastrophic encounter with an old land mine and lands the gang in trouble with the MacDonaghs again.

videos.title: Hans
videos.overview: Tommo gets the surprise of his life when a young German man shows up looking for him.

videos.title: Sweet Sixteen
videos.overview: Erin's dad dies, leaving her with a debt to the local honchos, so the gang do what they do best to get the money - some cheeky thievery.

videos.title: Ratcatcher
videos.overview: A ratcatcher is hired to help with Jim's rat problem, but it is soon clear it's him who needs help.

videos.title: Caravan of Courage
videos.overview: A caravan with some precious cargo goes missing and the gang are tasked with getting it back.

videos.title: Albert
videos.overview: A giant bunny, a crocodile and a golf buggy chase - Cardi goes on a mission that'll truly test his mettle.

videos.title: The Manolito Problem
videos.overview: In their biggest heist yet, the gang steals some rare Lowry paintings.

videos.title: Stolen FA Cup
videos.overview: Vinnie meets a seasoned criminal with something interesting stashed in his attic - the original FA Cup from 1895 stolen by his Grandad.

videos.title: That Night
videos.overview: All is finally revealed when the gang revisit what happened THAT night with Manolito.

videos.title: Blast from the Past
videos.overview: Farmer Jim is forced on a trip down memory lane when an old flame pops up in Hawley. Also - JJ is back!

videos.title: Naked Cult
videos.overview: Tommo meets Craig, a once-famous dance arcade champion, as the gang try to rescue Gideon from a naked cult.

videos.title: Heartbreak
videos.overview: Cardi's mum shows up in Hawley - she is getting married.... again. Meanwhile, Carol gets a nasty shock of her own.

videos.title: The Mark
videos.overview: After being humiliated by some local youths, Ashley decides it's time to up his game - with the help of Jim and Cardi.

videos.title: Two Funerals and a Wedding
videos.overview: JJ and Sugar's joyous celebrations turn into a morbid affair after the gang learns of some sad news.

videos.title: The Bishops
videos.overview: As we head back to Hawley for the last hurrah, Vinnie is trying to lay low... in fact the whole gang seem to be taking a step back. That is until a new, younger gang are spotted and appear to be rivalling Vinnie's crew in local dodgy dealings. Even worse? It's led by Farmer Jim's estranged daughter, Ally and her girlfriend Fay... Vinnie and co are dragged in once again.

videos.title: Once Upon a Time in Dusseldorf
videos.overview: Tommo heads to Germany to impress Hans' mum, Veronika Fischer, and hopefully land some investment from Hans' grandfather. But his plans fall apart when Farmer Jim turns up on the next flight, hell-bent on tracking down 'bukkake' - and Tommo's the only one who can help. They stumble into a dodgy drug deal, and things escalate fast - from beerhalls and lederhosen to sledgehammers and trashed cars. This is one night to remember.

videos.title: Skool Reunion
videos.overview: A school reunion transports the gang back to their past. Ronnie comes face to face with his old bully and dreams of revenge. But be careful what you wish for... he unwittingly makes a deal with a psycho ex-classmate, Bruno. Before long there's a missing person and all fingers are pointing at Ronnie.

videos.title: The Wizard Of E
videos.overview: Curtis Plum used to DJ illegal raves back in the 90s. Val & Vern fell in love to his acid house mixes - and now, with Vern terminally ill, Val wants to give him one last dance. But Curtis can't do it without his old hype man, the Wizard of E. Problem is, the Wizard disappeared years ago, prompting the gang to set out and track the Wizard down.

videos.title: Halloween Heist
videos.overview: It's Halloween and an old enemy of the MacDonagh's has died. Davey refuses to let him rest in peace and ropes the gang into stealing his corpse before the funeral. Using Halloween as a cover, they dress the corpse up as a mummy to get it out undetected, only to get themselves into a mummy mix-up fiasco with another Halloween reveller...

videos.title: The Carvery
videos.overview: Davey MacDonagh finally loses with it with Joey Kittens at an all-you-can-eat carvery in the middle of a snowstorm. Thanks to the storm, Vinnie and the gang get stuck in the middle of Davey's carnage and it turns out he's got hostages all over the gaff. As things turn from blizzard to bloodbath it's clear that not everyone is getting out alive.

awards: Nominated for 5 BAFTA 3 wins & 18 nominations total
